title: Concession MC-07: digging beyond the permit

story.headline: A sand and gravel pit that grew past its permit toward the river
story.context: Operator "Golden Bank Aggregates" (fictional) holds a permit to dig inside the yellow boundary. Head office cannot visit the site through the monsoon, and clouds hide it from optical satellites for weeks. Every 12 days NISAR's L-band radar sees it anyway.
story.radar_insight: Forest canopy scatters radar many times between leaves and branches (volume scattering), which keeps its cross-polarised (HV) return bright. Clearing and digging leave bare, rough ground that returns far less HV signal, so a drop of more than 3 dB marks newly cleared land. InSAR adds two clues: active digging destroys coherence between passes, and the ground beside the pit sinking away from the satellite warns of riverbank collapse.

sensor.insar_product: NISAR L2 GUNW (geocoded unwrapped interferogram: phase and coherence)

validation.note: Detected new clearing on the latest pass compared with the simulation's own ground truth.
